messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the skirt, top, and footwear shown in the reference images. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete target outfit, and the second shows its back view. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects of the person and scene unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the person's whole outfit with the skirt, the top, and the footwear, as shown from the front and back in the reference images. Keep only the clothing and footwear belonging to this target outfit, and leave all non-clothing aspects unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in the middle of a road, shifting her weight and turning her body slightly from side to side.","camera":"A static, low-angle full shot that keeps the figure centered in the frame.","clothing":"A short, form-fitting dress with a black, white, and orange pattern, featuring a white lace-up front and black sleeves, paired with light blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair styled into two high buns on top of the head.","identity":"A slender female figure with a stylized, computer-generated appearance and a smooth, featureless face.","scene":"An outdoor paved road under a concrete overpass, lined with orange and white construction barriers, metal railings, and green trees on the right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The pink top and pink skirt with black boots were replaced by a black-and-gold floral dress with a white lace-up front, black sleeves, and light blue sneakers. The figure's pose, hair, face, scene, and camera remained largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the skirt, top, and footwear shown in the reference images, keeping only the target clothing and footwear while leaving all non-clothing aspects unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the new dress exactly matches the reference outfit in all details, especially the back view and sleeve shape, is difficult to verify from the video frames.
